org: Sonos — Data visualisation guidelines (by Agency SR)
accessNotes: The guideline document itself is not public. Agency SR's case-study page has only a short description; all specifics were read visually from 1920×1080 mock-up photos of ~12 guideline spreads (pages 15–16, 21–22, 33–34, 47, 52, 54, 62, 67, 69, 71, 75, 104–105). Secondary palette hex values were read from a zoomed crop of page 15. The primary palette page, typography page and axis/number-format pages were not shown, so fonts and sizes are inferred from appearance only.
summary: Brand/infographic data-design system for Sonos presentations and partner agencies: stark white (or reversed black) pages, SONOS wordmark top-left, huge bold black sans 'Chart title' set inside the graphic, and saturated flat colour fields of coral red, teal green and ultramarine blue plus black. Charts are 'hero data' graphics — fan/radial bars, full-bleed stacked bars, bubble clusters, treemaps and layered areas — with Regular-weight labels and Bold values, circular legend swatches and dotted/dashed axes.

colors.categoricalNotes: Secondary palette ('introduced when there are multiple categories and when incorporating data from brand competitors'): Red #FD4F57, Green #00948E, Blue #2B2AA8, each with 80/60/40/20% tints. Examples consistently use red, green (teal), blue and black/dark grey as the series set. Black as fourth series is observed, not a stated hex. Patterns (Hatch, Dotted, Waves) are used before adding another colour.
colors.notes: Tint ramps from page 15: Red 80% #FD7279, 60% #FE959A, 40% #FEB9BC, 20% #FFDCDD; Green 80% #33A9A5, 60% #66BFBB, 40% #99D4D2, 20% #CCEAE8; Blue 80% #5555B9, 60% #807FCB, 40% #AAAADC, 20% #D5D4EE (sequential above = Blue ramp). Primary palette page not visible. All charts have a reversed dark/black-background version (icons and dashboards shown both ways). Background and text colours are observed (white page, black type), not stated hex.

typography.family: Neo-grotesque sans (Helvetica/Neue Haas-like in the spreads; not named in visible pages)

axisTitle.placement: small rotated title beside the axis in fan chart; usually omitted

dataLabel.weight: bold for values, regular for labels

typography.notes: Consistent two-weight system: category labels in 'Regular', values in 'Bold'. Value label point size scales with the size of the section/segment it sits in (large stacked bar, treemap). Horizontal axis increments in Bold (area graph); vertical axis labels in Regular. Page header: chart-type name in bold with 'hero data' in regular beneath, beside the SONOS wordmark.

structure.gridlines: Dotted (area graph) or dashed (stacked area) horizontal value-axis lines stretching the width of the graph; dotted concentric circular axes on fan charts.
structure.axisLine: No solid axis lines; bars/areas sit on a baseline at the start of bars.
structure.ticks: White vertical line markers at each horizontal-axis increment, running up to the highest value (stacked area).
structure.frame: none; charts often bleed to page edges ('Graph scaled to the full dimensions of the page').
structure.notes: Where data overlaps the axis, axis labels can be reversed out in white. Horizontal-axis labels sit to the right of their marker except the last, which aligns left.

legend.placement: under the chart title (fan, donut) or top-right / aligned to the top line of the vertical axis (area charts)
legend.directLabels: Bubbles, treemap tiles, large stacked bars and radial bars carry label + value directly.
legend.title: not shown
legend.notes: Legend text Regular weight with circular swatches; where colours overlap, legend swatches can use Multiply blending.

marks.bars: Large stacked bar: no gap between sections, scaled to full page. Fan/radial bars: large gap between bars and sections, ranked in order of size. Don't use stacked bars with more than six data sets.
marks.areas: Flat opaque fills layered so the series with the lowest first value is in front; thin white lines drawn on top of each area to show overlaps; coloured circular markers (white outline) at each data point.
marks.points: Coloured circular markers with white stroke on area vertices.
marks.pies: Multiple (nested) donut rings allowed for multi-category part-to-whole; values bold inside the top of each section; large gaps between rings; pies used in dashboards with leader-line labels.
marks.notes: Bubble clusters with no gap, arranged large to small; treemap with white gaps between tiles, label/value bottom-left.

labels.dataLabels: Label (Regular) + value (Bold) inside the mark, at bottom-left (treemap, stacked bar), centre (bubble), base of bar (radial bar) or outside top of bar (fan).
labels.notes: Fan-chart labels rotate with the bar angle once it passes 90°.

furniture.title: Very large bold 'Chart title' set within the graphic, left-aligned to the start of the bars / outermost axis line / top-left of graph.
furniture.logo: SONOS wordmark top-left of every page/graphic; top-right in dashboard examples.
furniture.other: Page header rule with section name, 'Data visualization guidelines' and page number; layouts on a 9-column × 5-row grid for screen and 9 × 9 for print, with zones for titles (black), hero data (blue), secondary data (green) and body text (red). Line icon set (outline icons, also reversed).

layout: Screen grid 9 columns × 5 rows; print grid 9 × 9. Charts can be full-width for maximum impact or sized to fit with other content. 'Hero data' graphics fill most of the page.
accessibility: Three pattern fills (hatch, dotted, waves) support the palette and differentiate categories; consider a pattern before adding a colour.

discouraged: fan/radial charts when a precise comparison is needed
chartTypes.notes: Each chart page lists Pros / Cons / Do / Don't and offers Adobe Illustrator and PowerPoint templates.

distinctiveRules.rule: Series colours are coral red #FD4F57, teal green #00948E and ultramarine blue #2B2AA8 (plus black), each with 80/60/40/20% tints.
distinctiveRules.quote: Red ... Hex: #FD4F57; Green ... Hex: #00948E; Blue ... Hex: #2B2AA8

distinctiveRules.rule: Labels in Regular weight, values in Bold weight, consistently across chart types.
distinctiveRules.quote: Bubble label and value aligned to the center of each bubble. The label should be set in 'Regular' weight with the value in 'Bold'

distinctiveRules.rule: Huge bold 'Chart title' placed inside the graphic, left-aligned to the start of the bars/outermost axis.
distinctiveRules.quote: Chart title aligned to the start of the bars

distinctiveRules.rule: Legend uses circular swatches with Regular-weight text, placed directly under the title (or aligned to the top line of the vertical axis).
distinctiveRules.quote: Legend for sections set in 'Regular' weight with circular swatches aligned underneath the title

distinctiveRules.rule: Value axes are dotted/dashed lines spanning the graph width with Regular labels; x increments in Bold.
distinctiveRules.quote: Dotted line vertical axis stretching the width of the graph. Axis labels set in 'Regular' ... Horizontal axis increments labeled at the bottom of the graph in 'Bold' weight

distinctiveRules.rule: Area series layered with lowest first value in front; thin white lines on top of each area and coloured circular markers at each point.
distinctiveRules.quote: White lines on top of each colored area to show where data overlaps

distinctiveRules.rule: Large stacked bar: no gap between sections, scaled to the full page, label bottom-left with value size proportional to the section.
distinctiveRules.quote: No gap between sections ... Graph scaled to the full dimensions of the page

distinctiveRules.rule: Fan and radial bars: large gaps between bars, ranked by size; labels rotate as the bar angle passes 90°.
distinctiveRules.quote: Rotation of labels should change as the angle of the bar passes 90°

distinctiveRules.rule: Treemap tiles separated by white gaps; label and value at bottom-left of each tile, size relative to tile.
distinctiveRules.quote: Label and value aligned to the bottom left of each segment

distinctiveRules.rule: Bubbles clustered large-to-small with no gap between them.
SONOS wordmark at top-left of every graphic with chart-type name in bold beside it.
Every chart has both a white and a reversed black-background version.
distinctiveRules.quote: Print application example shows light and dark Listenership dashboards.

distinctiveRules.rule: Use hatch, dotted or wave pattern fills before adding another colour.
distinctiveRules.quote: Before using an additional color, consider if a pattern fill would instead be best suited.

distinctiveRules.rule: Layouts sit on a 9-column × 5-row grid (screen) or 9 × 9 (print).
distinctiveRules.quote: A 9 column by 5 row grid for screen use and 9 column by 9 row for print

referenceImages.describes: Stacked area graph spread (p.69). Left page: SONOS wordmark top-left, bold 'Stacked area graph' + regular 'hero data'. Full-bleed smooth stacked areas in ultramarine blue (bottom), teal and coral red (top), flat fills. Thin white vertical markers at each 'Time 01–06' increment running up to the top value; small circular markers with white outline at each data point and tiny 'xx' value labels; short left tick labels 0–100; bold white x labels inside the blue area. Legend of circle swatches top-right ('Group 01–03'). Right page: Pros/Cons/Do/Don't columns and numbered annotations.

Stacked fan bar chart (p.52): wedge-shaped radial stacked bars in blue (inner), teal and coral red (outer) radiating from a small white hub, white separators between wedges, faint dotted concentric circular axes, small rotated labels outside each bar. Large bold black 'Chart title' left of the fan with a Regular-weight circle-swatch legend (Group 01–03) directly beneath. Tiny vertical 0–100 scale with rotated 'Axis title'.

Print application example (p.104): two 'Listenership dashboard' posters, white and black versions. Bold two-line title top-left under a thin rule, small SONOS wordmark top-right. Row of three pies (coral red dominant with teal and blue slices) with thin leader lines to small coloured labels. Red hourglass icon with '% of total daily streams'. Large coral-red area chart with small white-ringed point markers, thin horizontal gridlines, tiny axis labels; area bleeds to the edges.
